items.title: Goldman Sachs (GS) Launches Private Markets Platform And Buys AEGIS Hedging Solutions
items.summary: Goldman Sachs Group (NYSE:GS) has launched a new private markets platform aimed at wealthy clients, expanding access to alternative investments. Goldman Sachs Alternatives has agreed to acquire AEGIS Hedging Solutions, a provider of risk management and hedging services. For investors watching how Goldman Sachs Group positions itself beyond traditional investment banking, these two moves sit squarely in its asset and wealth management efforts.
